title: Marconi radar and the Italian crash

tellings.quote:
not
just in Cape
Gerardo but maybe in Italy as well
because Marone was involved

plain: The idea here is that an unexplained crash may not have happened only at Cape Girardeau, in Missouri, but perhaps in Italy as well, and that Guglielmo Marconi, the Italian radio pioneer, was involved. John Blitch, a guest on the show who calls himself a witness to strange events, raises this in passing without naming a source and gives no further details. If it were true, crash stories would reach back into Italy and into the work of one of radio's founders.
